title: Commit Generation Pipeline Tests
description: Expand and create unit tests for the commit generation pipeline covering 5 key modules: (1) extend streaming-generation-helper.test.ts to cover system prompt hash, combined diff parsing, error mapping (RequestTooLargeError/too_large, cancel/cancelled), and fallbackToAll logic; (2) extend commit-generation-orchestrator.test.ts for single-repo reuse, cross-repo grouping, and crash fallback; (3) extend generate-commit-command.test.ts for cross-repo summary scenarios; (4) extend layered-commit-handler.test.ts for file-level diff extraction and regex parsing; (5) verify function-calling-handler.test.ts coverage is adequate.

criteria: 4 existing test files expanded: [streaming-generation-helper.test.ts, commit-generation-orchestrator.test.ts, generate-commit-command.test.ts, layered-commit-handler.test.ts] — verify each has new test cases added
1 existing test file verified: [function-calling-handler.test.ts] — confirm adequate coverage
streaming-generation-helper test coverage >= 80% — verify by npx vitest run --coverage src/commands/generate-commit/__tests__/streaming-generation-helper.test.ts
All cross-repository scenarios covered: [all-success, partial-success, cancelled] — verify by grep 'cross-repo\|multi-repo\|partial' in test file
Error mapping tests cover all ResultType variants — verify by grep 'too_large\|cancelled' in streaming test
All tests pass — verify by npx vitest run (exit code 0)
convergence.verification: npx vitest run src/commands/generate-commit && npx vitest run src/commands/generate-commit/handlers
convergence.definition_of_done: Commit generation pipeline has comprehensive unit tests covering streaming, orchestration, error mapping, and cross-repo scenarios

files.change: Add test cases for: system prompt hash changes on SCM type/workspace/prompt variation, combined diff parsing maps file hunks to absolute paths, error mapping (RequestTooLargeError->too_large, cancel->cancelled), fallbackToAll=false with auto detection exception

Add test cases for: single-repo reuse of grouped result and skip SCM detection, cross-repo grouping by repo with per-repo SCM detection, crash fallback (multi-resource abort, single-resource fallback)
Add test cases for: cross-repo summary (all success, partial success, cancelled), single-repo success notification + system notification
Add test cases for: file-level diff extraction, regex parsing of diff hunks, layered commit generation flow
Review and verify existing coverage is adequate; add missing edge case tests if gaps found

rationale.why: streaming-generation-helper.ts has 24x changes (highest in project), commit generation accounts for 25% of all code changes. Highest regression risk area.
rationale.approach: Extend existing tests (not rewrite) with new describe blocks for uncovered scenarios, using shared mocks from IMPL-001

risks.risk: Existing tests have complex mock setup that may conflict with new shared mocks
risks.mitigation: Use vi.hoisted() pattern from existing tests; shared mocks provide defaults, per-test overrides with vi.mock at file level
